INSERT INTO S_DAY_GOODS_SALE_SUM ( ORDER_DT, GOODS_CODE, GIFT_TYPE, BRAND_CODE, ORDER_CNT, ORDER_AMT, ORDER_CNCL_CNT, ORDER_CNCL_AMT, REG_DATE, UPD_DATE ) SELECT PA.ORDER_DT , PA.GOODS_CODE , PA.GIFT_TYPE , PA.BRAND_CODE , SUM(PA.ORDER_CNT) AS ORDER_CNT , SUM(PA.ORDER_AMT) AS ORDER_AMT , SUM(PA.ORDER_CNCL_CNT) AS ORDER_CNCL_CNT , SUM(PA.ORDER_CNCL_AMT) AS ORDER_CNCL_AMT , SYSDATE AS REG_DATE , SYSDATE AS UPD_DATE FROM ( SELECT /*+ USE_NL(A B C) INDEX(A T_ORDER_IDX4) INDEX(C T_GOODS_PK) */ TO_CHAR(A.ORDER_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS ORDER_DT , B.GOODS_CODE AS GOODS_CODE , B.BRAND_CODE AS BRAND_CODE , (CASE WHEN A.USER_PHONE = A.RCV_PHONE THEN 'M' ELSE 'G' END) AS GIFT_TYPE , SUM(B.ORDER_QTY) AS ORDER_CNT , SUM(B.ORDER_AMT) AS ORDER_AMT , 0 AS ORDER_CNCL_CNT , 0 AS ORDER_CNCL_AMT FROM T_ORDER A , T_ORDER_INFO B , T_GOODS C WHERE A.ORDER_CODE = B.ORDER_CODE AND A.ORDER_NO = B.ORDER_NO AND B.GOODS_CODE = C.GOODS_CODE AND A.ORDER_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{baseDt},'YYYYMMDD') AND A.ORDER_DATE < TO_DATE(#{baseDt},'YYYYMMDD') + 1 AND A.ORDER_STATE <> '00' AND (A.MTPL_SEND_YN IS NULL OR C.GOODS_TYPE NOT IN ('0','6','7')) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(A.ORDER_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') , B.GOODS_CODE , B.BRAND_CODE , (CASE WHEN A.USER_PHONE = A.RCV_PHONE THEN 'M' ELSE 'G' END)
UNION ALL
SELECT /*+ USE_NL(A B C D) INDEX(A T_ORDER_IDX4) INDEX(C T_GOODS_PK) */ TO_CHAR(A.ORDER_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS ORDER_DT , B.GOODS_CODE AS GOODS_CODE , B.BRAND_CODE AS BRAND_CODE , (CASE WHEN A.USER_PHONE = D.RCV_PHONE THEN 'M' ELSE 'G' END) AS GIFT_TYPE , COUNT(*) AS ORDER_CNT , SUM(B.ORDER_AMT / B.ORDER_QTY) AS ORDER_AMT , 0 AS ORDER_CNCL_CNT , 0 AS ORDER_CNCL_AMT FROM T_ORDER A , T_ORDER_INFO B , T_GOODS C , T_HAPPYCON_COUPON_MULTI D WHERE A.ORDER_CODE = B.ORDER_CODE AND A.ORDER_NO = B.ORDER_NO AND B.GOODS_CODE = C.GOODS_CODE AND A.ORDER_NO = D.ORDER_NO AND A.ORDER_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{baseDt},'YYYYMMDD') AND A.ORDER_DATE < TO_DATE(#{baseDt},'YYYYMMDD') + 1 AND A.ORDER_STATE <> '00' AND A.MTPL_SEND_YN = '1' AND C.GOODS_TYPE IN ('0','6','7') GROUP BY TO_CHAR(A.ORDER_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') , B.GOODS_CODE , B.BRAND_CODE , (CASE WHEN A.USER_PHONE = D.RCV_PHONE THEN 'M' ELSE 'G' END)
UNION ALL
SELECT /*+ USE_NL(M A B C) INDEX(A T_ORDER_IDX1) INDEX(C T_GOODS_PK) */ M.ORDER_DT , B.GOODS_CODE AS GOODS_CODE , B.BRAND_CODE AS BRAND_CODE , (CASE WHEN A.USER_PHONE = A.RCV_PHONE THEN 'M' ELSE 'G' END) AS GIFT_TYPE , 0 AS ORDER_CNT , 0 AS ORDER_AMT , SUM(B.ORDER_QTY) AS ORDER_CNCL_CNT , SUM(B.ORDER_AMT) AS ORDER_CNCL_AMT FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(CNCL_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS ORDER_DT , ORDER_NO FROM T_ORDER_CANCEL WHERE CNCL_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{baseDt},'YYYYMMDD') AND CNCL_DATE < TO_DATE(#{baseDt},'YYYYMMDD') + 1 ) M , T_ORDER A , T_ORDER_INFO B , T_GOODS C WHERE M.ORDER_NO = A.ORDER_NO AND A.ORDER_CODE = B.ORDER_CODE AND A.ORDER_NO = B.ORDER_NO AND B.GOODS_CODE = C.GOODS_CODE AND (A.MTPL_SEND_YN IS NULL OR C.GOODS_TYPE NOT IN ('0','6','7')) GROUP BY M.ORDER_DT , B.GOODS_CODE , B.BRAND_CODE , (CASE WHEN A.USER_PHONE = A.RCV_PHONE THEN 'M' ELSE 'G' END)
UNION ALL
SELECT /*+ USE_NL(M A B C D) INDEX(A T_ORDER_IDX1) INDEX(C T_GOODS_PK) */ M.ORDER_DT , B.GOODS_CODE AS GOODS_CODE , B.BRAND_CODE AS BRAND_CODE , (CASE WHEN A.USER_PHONE = D.RCV_PHONE THEN 'M' ELSE 'G' END) AS GIFT_TYPE , 0 AS ORDER_CNT , 0 AS ORDER_AMT , COUNT(*) AS ORDER_CNCL_CNT , SUM(B.ORDER_AMT / B.ORDER_QTY) AS ORDER_CNCL_AMT FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(CNCL_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS ORDER_DT , ORDER_NO FROM T_ORDER_CANCEL WHERE CNCL_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{baseDt},'YYYYMMDD') AND CNCL_DATE < TO_DATE(#{baseDt},'YYYYMMDD') + 1 ) M , T_ORDER A , T_ORDER_INFO B , T_GOODS C , T_HAPPYCON_COUPON_MULTI D WHERE M.ORDER_NO = A.ORDER_NO AND A.ORDER_CODE = B.ORDER_CODE AND A.ORDER_NO = B.ORDER_NO AND B.GOODS_CODE = C.GOODS_CODE AND A.ORDER_NO = D.ORDER_NO AND A.MTPL_SEND_YN = '1' AND C.GOODS_TYPE IN ('0','6','7') GROUP BY M.ORDER_DT , B.GOODS_CODE , B.BRAND_CODE , (CASE WHEN A.USER_PHONE = D.RCV_PHONE THEN 'M' ELSE 'G' END) ) PA GROUP BY PA.ORDER_DT , PA.GOODS_CODE , PA.GIFT_TYPE , PA.BRAND_CODE
